column2: the plan writes `oos-dropped-before-vote.md` and emits `pre_vote_*` review-core rows, but dropped-oos evidence is not reliably available after the run. `_round_artifact_allow` in `python/run_logs.py` does not include the audit file (and `oos.md` is denylisted), so committed implement run logs cannot reconstruct pre-vote drops. separately, the gate writes `oos-dropped-before-vote.md` under `review_tmpdir` but never copies it to the implement parent like `rejected-findings.md`; nit-pruned oos exists only in `findings.md` (not `oos.md`), so after gate and tmpdir cleanup those drops can be lost and post-run `/issue` follow-up from logs is incomplete.

the repo pins full `review core` stdout order in `test_emit_review_core_result_stdout_order_matches_rows`. adding `pre_vote_*` rows on the post-prune path will change emitted order for parametrized branches (`emit-fix-required`, `emit-agg-exhaust`, etc.) and fail ci unless the harness expectations move in the same change.

the plan appends `pre_vote_oos_dropped_count`, `pre_vote_oos_dropped_file`, and `pre_vote_findings_remaining` to the local `rows` list, then routes all-oos cases through `_zero_findings_branch(...)`. that helper currently returns its own tuple and drops caller-supplied rows. both all-oos exits (normal and validation-exhausted short-circuits) therefore omit the new pre_vote_* kvs from review-core stdout, so the audit contract is invisible exactly in the zero-findings case the plan is meant to prove.

on the normal path, wire points run `prune-nit-findings` then the pre-vote gate before proposer-map. the `reason=validation-exhausted` branch at `python/review_pipeline.py:2297-2327` runs before the `prune-nit-findings` call at line 2332 and inserts gate-only handling. nit-severity blocks in unmerged `findings.md` never get `[out_of_scope]` headings, so they stay on the fallback ballot and reach proposer-map/tally/manual adjudication instead of being dropped. if the gate then removes every remaining block, the branch still builds a proposer map and runs fallback tally, yielding `aggregator-validation-exhausted` or `main-agent-vote-required` instead of routing through `_zero_findings_branch` as integration tests expect on the normal path.

the new gate helper is specified to call `review_types.parse_findings_text(...)`, but this module is not imported in `review_pipeline.py`. that path will raise `nameerror` the first time the pre-vote oos gate runs, so code review cannot reach the new ballot-splitting logic.

`_is_oos_ballot_block` uses substring match on the heading line; `ballot_parse` uses a title-prefix check. the plan classifies oos when the first line contains `[out_of_scope]` or `[oos]`. an in-scope title like `### finding_1: fix [out_of_scope] parser handling` would be dropped before voting while `ballot_parse` and voters would treat it as in-scope.

the planned helper calls `_copy_to_parent(..., session_env_path=session_env_path)` when `dropped_count > 0`, but its declared signature only lists `commands`, `review_tmpdir`, and `runner`. implementing the signature literally leaves `session_env_path` unbound (`nameerror`) or forces ad-hoc globals/closure wiring, so `oos-dropped-before-vote.md` never reaches the implement parent on `--session-env-path` runs.

the plan says the helper appends `pre_vote_*` rows to the caller `rows` list, but the helper signature has no `rows` argument and returns only `(prune_result, gate_result)`. wiring steps also tell the caller to append the same rows again. that can duplicate `pre_vote_*` stdout keys or drop them on all-oos `prefix_rows` paths.

the plan wires `_zero_findings_branch(..., prefix_rows=tuple(rows))` where `rows` already starts with `dispatch_scout_rows` (see `review_pipeline.py:2210`), then examples return `dispatch_scout_rows + zero.rows`. that double-emits `scout_status` / `dynamic_slots` / `panel_pruned_empty` and any `pre_vote_*` rows, breaking stdout-order harnesses. conversely, the normal-path bullet omits an explicit `dispatch_scout_rows + zero.rows` return, so an implementer may return `zero.rows` alone and drop scout kvs. the contract must pick one envelope shape and apply it consistently on both normal and validation-exhausted all-oos exits.

the plan routes durability through `_copy_to_parent(..., name="oos-dropped-before-vote.md")` and the failure-modes section says fail closed when `session_env_path` is set, but `_copy_to_parent` wraps `shutil.copyfile` in `contextlib.suppress(oserror)`. a full tmpdir can still hold the audit while the implement parent lacks `oos-dropped-before-vote.md`, with no warning and no failed review-core status.

plan item 3 requires `_flush_round_log` on every exit path that ran the gate so `pre-vote-oos-gate.env` and `oos-dropped-before-vote.md` reach committed run logs via `_round_artifact_allow`. both `proposer-map-failed` returns (validation-exhausted and normal) return immediately without `_flush_round_log`, so gate artifacts stay in the session tmpdir only.

the plan gates only the normal `reason=ok` path with `merged_count != 0`, but `review_aggregate` accepts an attestation-only merge as `reason=ok` and `merged_count=0` even when input findings existed. if an oos-only round is empty-merged, `_review_core_body` takes the existing zero-findings return at ~2328-2330 before the planned gate, so it writes no `pre-vote-oos-gate.env`, no `oos-dropped-before-vote.md`, and no `pre_vote_*` rows for the dropped oos audit.

after `_prune_nit_then_pre_vote_gate` runs, `tally-code-votes` failure exits on both the validation-exhausted path (~2317-2318) and the normal path (~2385-2387) return `reviewcoreresult(2, panel_failed)` without calling `_flush_round_log`. the plan only wires flush before proposer-map failures. `pre-vote-oos-gate.env` and `oos-dropped-before-vote.md` then remain in the session tmpdir only, so committed implement run logs cannot reconstruct pre-vote oos drops even with the new allowlist.

the empty-merge branch (`reason=ok` and `merged_count=0`) unconditionally calls `_zero_findings_branch` after gating the pre-aggregate snapshot. if the gated snapshot still has in-scope findings, those findings are dropped from voter dispatch instead of continuing through proposer-map and voters.

snapshot creation for the `merged_count=0` path has no failure handling. if copying `findings.md` to `findings-pre-aggregate.md` fails or the snapshot is missing after a non-empty collect, the plan silently falls back to today's zero-findings branch and emits no pre-vote audit for an empty merge.

the plan specifies `_copy_gate_audit_to_parent` calling `_copy_to_parent`, which suppresses `oserror` (see `review_pipeline.py:1796-1799`). when `session_env_path` is set and the parent directory is full or unwritable, `oos-dropped-before-vote.md` never reaches the implement parent, but the round can continue as if the audit were persisted despite the plan's fail-closed intent.

`_copy_gate_audit_to_parent` is specified to raise on `shutil.copyfile` failure, but `_prune_nit_then_pre_vote_gate` callers are not told to catch and return `reviewcoreresult(2, panel_failed, ...)`. an unhandled exception aborts review core instead of the existing fail-closed panel-failed envelope, so implement runs lose structured status and may skip `_flush_round_log`.

on the empty-merge path, item 1 runs the gate against `findings-pre-aggregate.md` then always routes to `_zero_findings_branch` while leaving post-aggregate `findings.md` attestation-only/empty. `remaining_count` is computed on the snapshot, so a round where the aggregator empty-merged away in-scope input can emit `pre_vote_findings_remaining>0` while `review_core_status=zero_findings` and voters see an empty ballot. audit rows then contradict runtime behavior.

pre-vote gate i/o failures are not consistently routed through structured `panel_failed` exits on all post-aggregate branches. the plan catches `prevotegatecopyerror` only on empty-merge and validation-exhausted paths, not the normal path, so parent-copy failures on the common path can raise out of `_review_core_body` instead of returning the planned structured result and `_flush_round_log` may be skipped. even when a copy failure is caught, `_copy_gate_audit_to_parent` raising after ballot rewrite can prevent `_prune_nit_then_pre_vote_gate` from handing the caller a `gate_result`, so `_post_gate_panel_failed_exit` cannot emit `pre_vote_oos_dropped_count`, `pre_vote_oos_dropped_file`, or `pre_vote_findings_remaining`. audit/env write errors are also not covered by a unified gate-failure path.

the plan's `_post_gate_panel_failed_exit` calls `_core_common_rows` with only `status` and `threshold_reason`, but `_core_common_rows` requires `round_num`, `review_tmpdir`, `panel_mode`, and `panel_shape` (see `review_pipeline.py:1957`). a literal implementation raises `typeerror` on every post-gate `panel_failed` exit (proposer-map, tally, parent-copy, snapshot-missing).

item 2 of the plan requires `rows.extend(_pre_vote_gate_rows(gate))` after the gate; item 3 (validation-exhausted) does not. all-oos validation-exhausted returns use `tuple(rows) + zero.rows` without gate rows, and continuation paths emit no `pre_vote_*` stdout keys despite tests requiring them (`plan.txt:191-195`). that breaks the stdout contract and leaves the validation-exhausted brake unaudited.

the approach pseudocode at plan.txt:98-104 still shows only `status="panel-failed"` (and a bare `return reviewcoreresult(...)`) without `_flush_round_log` or the full `_core_common_rows` kwargs (`round_num`, `review_tmpdir`, `panel_mode`, `panel_shape`, `threshold_reason`). that contradicts the complete contract at plan.txt:164-167 and `review_pipeline.py:1957`. a top-down implementer copying the approach block will raise `typeerror` on every post-gate `panel_failed` exit.

when `merged_count=0` and the pre-vote gate leaves in-scope findings (`gate.remaining_count > 0`), the plan copies the gated snapshot back into `findings.md` and falls through to proposer-map/voters. that copy/rewrite has no `oserror` handling. on disk-full, permission, or other i/o failure, `findings.md` can remain attestation-only or partial while `pre_vote_*` rows report remaining findings, so voter dispatch runs on the wrong or empty ballot and in-scope findings are silently dropped.
